The test image shows tomato leaves with **large, irregular dark brown/black necrotic blotches** extending from leaf margins, with surrounding **yellow chlorotic areas**. There are also small scattered dark spots on the less-affected parts of the leaves.

Comparing to the Late Blight reference: the reference images show nearly identical large, irregular dark brown blotches with the oily/greasy appearance spreading from leaf edges — this matches the test image very closely.

Key distinguishing features:
- Large irregular brown-to-black necrotic patches (not concentric-ringed like Early Blight/Target Spot)
- Blotches extend from leaf margins inward
- Yellow halo surrounding the dark lesions
- No fine concentric rings, no small discrete lesions like Septoria or Bacterial Spot
